description: Config form spec for one thermalprotection Sensor entry in devicecfg.json Sensors[]. Flattened Properties; native DTDL writable + Enum coverage; the rest is in config-rules.js. Thermal protection sensors expose a single boolean capability flag.
comment: Every thermalprotection MetricName -> wire schema 'boolean'. Schema invariant enforced by config-rules.js.

schemas.description: Allowed values of Parameters.MetricName when MetricType='thermalprotection'.
SensorGroup allow-list for thermalprotection sensors. Conventionally 'SYS'.
Wire schema allow-list. Every thermalprotection MetricName -> 'boolean'.

contents.name: Name
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty ASCII string, 1..128 chars, unique within Sensors[]. Uniqueness enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Name
UI hint: text input on create; read-only after.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: SensorGroup
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from the SensorGroup enum (thermalprotection sensors use 'SYS').
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorGroup
UI hint: dropdown, default 'SYS'.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: MetricType
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'thermalprotection' for this Interface.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricType
UI hint: fixed label, not editable.
Writable: immutable -- changing it requires defining a new Sensor.

contents.name: MetricName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST be a value from ThermalProtectionMetricName.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Parameters.MetricName
UI hint: dropdown.
Writable: immutable after creation.

contents.name: Enabled
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: boolean.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Enabled
UI hint: toggle / switch.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able (SIL2 maintenance lever).

contents.name: Interval
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: integer, 1 <= v <= 300000 (5 minutes). Range enforced by config-rules.js.
Maps to: Sensors[i].Report.Interval
UI hint: number input, min=1, max=300000, step=100, default=6000.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Description
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Description
UI hint: textarea or text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: DisplayName
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: non-empty string.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.DisplayName
UI hint: short text input.
Writable: twin desired-property sync-able.

contents.name: Schema
contents.description:
REQUIRED.
VALIDATION RULE: MUST equal 'boolean' for every thermalprotection MetricName. Enforced by config-rules.js; the agent rejects startup on mismatch.
Maps to: Sensors[i].SensorInfo.Schema
UI hint: dropdown, default 'boolean'.
Writable: immutable after creation.
